paragraphs.text: Being in great distress and sorrow.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: depths have I cried unto thee

paragraphs.text: He declares that we cannot be just before God but by forgiveness of sins.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Because by nature you are merciful therefore the faithful revere you.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He shows to whom the mercy of God belongs, that is, Israel, to the Church and not the reprobate.
paragraphs.label: d
